comment: ROMtool RF-link auto-draft mapping (phase E4, v0.7.0) - every catalog mapping and allowance multiplier lives here; romtool/rflink.py only reads it. The draft definition is a REVIEW draft: the estimator edits quantities/access/conditions before pricing. Draft source data comes from the RF project model: antenna elements per floor, cable_run lengths per cable_id (same-floor vs cross-floor riser detected from the endpoints' floors), splitter/coupler/tapper counts (hub closets), source/repeater floors (headend), critical-area polygons, solved-band count.
location_prefix_note: Draft location ids are the RF model floor ids prefixed with this prefix to avoid collisions with hand-built estimate locations.

lmr400.note: 3/8in-class branch coax is pulled to the 1/2in Heliax card (E01); 3/8 pull is faster - estimator re-cards on review.

coax_7_8in.note: 7/8in trunk re-card to a 7/8-specific unit when the company adds one; E01 is the closest shipped card.

riser_note: A cable_run whose endpoints sit on model floors of different levels is drafted as vertical riser footage (E02) on the floor that owns the run (the from-element's floor).

riser_fire_wrap.note: 2-hr riser fire wrap LF proportional to riser footage.

antenna_note: Ceiling omni (E06) is the default antenna card; estimator swaps to E07 hard-lid / E08 wall-mount per room conditions.

headend_lines.derivation: surge suppression at AC + RF entry
off-air donor antenna mount/aim/seal (donor side of the headend)
rooftop cable entry port (assumed; relocate if the donor path is not rooftop)

booster_load.note: Steady DC load assumption for the booster + headend electronics (practice allowance, assumption-grade). The engine auto-sizes the O-zone plant from this block: Ah = runtime x load, strings = ceil(Ah / string_Ah), rectifiers N+1. IFC 510.4.2.3 12-hr runtime.

power_feed_lines.derivation: dedicated circuit home run to the headend
breakers for headend + DC plant feeds

pathway_support.derivation: J-hooks/supports proportional to the floor's pulled coax footage

l_zone_allowance.tiles_note: ceiling tiles lifted/reinstalled per antenna point (practice allowance)
l_zone_allowance.patches_note: patch/finish allowance proportional to penetration rows (roof port, sleeves, core drills) drafted on the same location

engineering_lines.derivation: RF design / propagation model per floor

testing.per_band_note: H04/H05 qty = floors x solved bands when per_band is true (unit FLOOR = floor-band test passes); else floors only, one walk covering all bands.
testing.carriers_note: H09 qty = distinct solved band count (each band counted as an acceptance scope) unless carriers_override is set.
